whiff.definition:
n. a lefteye flounder found in coastal waters from New England to Brazil
n. a strikeout resulting from the batter swinging at and missing the ball for the third strike
v. drive or carry as if by a puff of air
v. strike out by swinging and missing the pitch charged as the third
whiff.translation:
n. 一吹, 一吸, 一阵, 一点点, 一口烟
vi. 轻轻地吹, 喷气, 三击不中出局, 垂钓
vt. 吹送, 喷出, 吸, 使三击不中出局

whiffed.translation: v. 些微的气味、空气或烟( whiff的过去式和过去分词 ); （呼吸时）吸入的少量的某物; <口>难闻的气味

whiffen.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 惠芬 Wiffen的变体

whiffer.translation: whiff（吹送, 吹起；喷）的变形

whiffet.definition: n. A little whiff or puff.
whiffet.translation: n. 小狗, 无名小卒, 轻轻一吹

whiffing.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Whiff
n. The act of one who, or that which, whiffs.
n. A mode of fishing with a hand line for pollack, mackerel,
   and the like.
whiffing.translation: v. 些微的气味、空气或烟( whiff的现在分词 ); （呼吸时）吸入的少量的某物; <口>难闻的气味

whiffle.definition:
v. i. To waver, or shake, as if moved by gusts of wind; to
   shift, turn, or veer about.
v. i. To change from one opinion or course to another; to use
   evasions; to prevaricate; to be fickle.
v. t. To disperse with, or as with, a whiff, or puff; to
   scatter.
v. t. To wave or shake quickly; to cause to whiffle.
n. A fife or small flute.
whiffle.translation:
vi. 风一阵阵地吹, 风时时变向, (喻)反复无常, 动摇不定
vt. 吹散

whiffled.translation: v. 徐缓地吹, 摇动( whiffle的过去式和过去分词 )

whiffler.definition:
n. One who whiffles, or frequently changes his opinion or
   course; one who uses shifts and evasions in argument; hence, a trifler.
n. One who plays on a whiffle; a fifer or piper.
n. An officer who went before procession to clear the way by
   blowing a horn, or otherwise; hence, any person who marched at the head
   of a procession; a harbinger.
n. The golden-eye.
whiffler.translation: n. 经常改变主意的人, 无定见者, 使用遁辞的人, 诡辩者

whiffles.translation: 徐缓地吹, 摇动( whiffle的第三人称单数 )

whiffletree.definition: n a crossbar that is attached to the traces of a draft horse and to the vehicle or implement that the horse is pulling

whiffling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Whiffle
whiffling.translation: v. 徐缓地吹, 摇动( whiffle的现在分词 )

whifflow.translation: n. <俚>[海]小机件,小装置[臆造词]

whiffs.definition:
n a short light gust of air
n a lefteye flounder found in coastal waters from New England to Brazil
n a strikeout resulting from the batter swinging at and missing the ball for the third strike
v perceive by inhaling through the nose
v drive or carry as if by a puff of air
v strike out by swinging and missing the pitch charged as the third
v smoke and exhale strongly
v utter with a puff of air
whiffs.translation:
n. 些微的气味、空气或烟( whiff的名词复数 ); （呼吸时）吸入的少量的某物; <口>难闻的气味
v. 些微的气味、空气或烟( whiff的第三人称单数 ); （呼吸时）吸入的少量的某物; <口>难闻的气味
